_about: Hand-kept mount points, in pixels of the 256 tower canvas, per state (t1, t2, t3a, t3b). pivot: where a turret's centre goes, only for turret towers off the default (128, 99 / 102 / 107 / 107, i.e. 0.5 tile above the cell centre). emit: where beams and muzzle flashes start, for towers without a turret (default: the same point as the default pivot). scripts/sprites.py merges this with each turret's measured reach into public/sprites/mounts.json. Emitters set by eye from the v2 art drop (2026-10-27). Pivots for the mortar, pile driver, whirlseed and acid bloat set by eye on the 2026-10-27 rework bodies, which grew taller at T2/T3 with a socket at their new top (v0.15.2).
